author: SoulExcuse
quote: Boring characters. This isn't GTA. This is a girlfriend simulator. You can't kill protestors or the people in gay bars.. but you can in straight bars! You can't steal cars in your neighborhood. You have to get flowers, and groceries for your girlfriend for the first 15 hours. $100 for this is nonsense.

author: SoulExcuse
quote: No 3 laps in online. Boring transition periods where you drive on open roads waiting to get to the actual track. This makes up most of the gameplay and you only get to do ONE lap on the actual track. Bring back lapped tracks, even if you have to add teleports.

author: SoulExcuse
quote: 10 out of the original 55 tracks as far as the music goes... There's many classic levels missing. There are zero animals in the zoo, no girls on the cruise ship, no plane in suburbia, no jokes in the airport and so many cool things missing. The soul of what this game was is completely gone with bouncy animation straight from robo Moto's Tony hawk's pro skater 5. This is a Tony hawk pro skater 5 reskin yet again. After 4 years we waited for this? Because of the bouncy animations the game doesn't just feel weird it doesn't play correctly with the same timing as the classic formula. The Tony hawk's pro skater 4 and thug formula was a pizza... You didn't need to remove those cheese or the sauce or the bread and create something entirely new... You just needed to put new ingredients on that amazing pizza... Instead they have removed all of the punk rock elements like  beautiful women, Great music, incredible animation that mimics real skating, and an overall feeling of being a rebel or having fun in a skate world. This is a sanitized, plastic, woke, reinterpretation of the original games that made me so sad to play I ended up firing up an emulator and just playing the old game. If you at all care about the game skip this and vote with your wallet. I'm happy that I have game pass so I didn't have to buy it but I did play through it all the way.. It's a piece **** product and the way Tony hawk made excuses for the missing tracks claiming he was some sort of DJ getting to select tracks for the new game was so egotistical that I'm even ashamed I gave this man my money for the old games. Can you tell I'm mad? This game ****. Skip it. It's a disgrace to Tony hawk 3 and Tony hawk 4 which had amazing soundtracks and amazing gameplay and amazing levels... Literally none of those are here. 45 missing tracks... Multiple missing levels and the levels that are here are completely stripped of what they used to be with missing NPCs, missing features and missing goals, and that amazing Tony hawk gameplay? It's not here either It's just that Tony hawk's pro skater 5 robo Moto Garbage gameplay with terrible animations. This game is so bad I'm literally starting a YouTube channel just to make a rant video about how awful this game is.

author: SoulExcuse
quote:
This game is definitely not worth its price.
The gameplay is a boring grind with no challenge and has nothing new to offer, the story is full of holes and simply garbage, the characters have no character and are forgettable, the multiplayer aspect is simply not there and half of the game is locked behind a paywall.
Destiny 2? No, its simply destiny 1.5. This whole series is a lie.

author: SoulExcuse
quote: Paid mods : Bethesda changed and became a greedy company by putting crappy paid mods in the game, mods that you have to download even if you don't want them... do like me, don't bother with their games anymore and boycott them !

author: SoulExcuse
quote: My main reaction to this game is the frustration of seeing how much missed potential there is for the franchise. There is so much more that Bungie can be doing with Destiny, and I was hoping they'd hit the nail on some of them with D2, but alas it's not the case. It's like no one at Bungie plays any MMOs that have really well designed customization and progression systems.

author: SoulExcuse
quote:
A very short game where the plot goes nowhere. Beautiful art direction that conveys the sense of an open world, but is really a series of corridors without any sort of gratifying exploration.

The game is centered around the plot, but the ending leaves you thinking "Well, that was a whole bunch of nothing."

Do not listen to the shills creaming their jeans, Firewatch is exceedingly mediocre.

author: SoulExcuse
quote: I would give this a 10 if the textures were higher res. The normal map and bump maps have been up res and so have many of the polys but not a lot of the textures. The first 2 games look great but the third looks the same but 60fps and 1080. Its very hard to tell WHAT was upgraded and what is just up scaled to 1080 and overall it just feels very much as I remember. I feel a bigger boost in graphics would have put this collection at a 10 out of 10. ****/SoulReason
